caption: The video captures a clear plastic bag of water holding a single white-and-red koi fish on a gray tiled tabletop, its left end gathered and tied with an orange band. Condensation droplets and a yellowish water layer coat the plastic. A long-haired brown-and-white cat sits at the right edge, its muzzle held close to the bag's pointed tip where the fish's head lies. The cat then lifts its head away from the plastic, turning its face from a low sniff into a more upright, frontal position. It shifts its seated body slightly, settling more upright while still gazing down at the bag. The framing shifts, sliding the tied left end of the bag out of view and revealing a terracotta pot and white pebbles along the top. The koi stays largely fixed inside the bag, its apparent displacement tied to the changing view rather than visible swimming.
